residents.name: Pavitra
residents.notes: allergic to wheat / avoids gluten entirely - ragi roti is her mandatory substitute at every meal, zero cross-contamination; does not eat bhindi; avoids chilli flakes; Monday evening fast (no ragi roti, no paneer bhurji that night); daily Ayurvedic amla shot at breakfast; sole primary contact for kitchen decisions

residents.name: Vikas
residents.notes: avoids besan/gram flour; dislikes gourds (lauki/tori) except as kofta ~biweekly; refuses carrot-beans sabzi; never capsicum sandwich again; daily protein shake; roti count drops to 2 on light-menu days

residents.name: Vidhi
residents.notes: daughter (child); no peas (matar) in any of her meals; daily filling paratha (methi/palak/dal, paneer paratha as favourite); 1 egg on egg days; asleep before 8 AM - no doorbell

notes: Confident in Indian vegetarian; needs guidance for Mediterranean/Asian/continental (chef-coach sessions).

person_rules.note: WHEAT ALLERGY: Pavitra's portion is always ragi roti / gluten-free; regular roti is cooked for Vikas and Vidhi separately (2 ragi + 2/3 normal). Zero cross-contamination with wheat flour.
Pavitra does not eat bhindi; it is still bought weekly for Vikas and Vidhi. Bhindi sabzi is made without onion.
Besan never used in Vikas's food.
Matar removed from all meals for Vidhi.

dish_keyword_rules.note: Bhindi sabzi is made without onion.
Cheese shredded/diced format only; eggs well cooked, never runny.

frequency_caps.name: Egg dishes
frequency_caps.note: Eggs for Pavitra & Vikas only; never Tue/Thu; 1 egg for Vidhi + 8 combined for the adults on egg days; must be well cooked.

weekday_rules.note: No eggs on Tuesdays (routine, not allergy).
No eggs on Thursdays (routine, not allergy).
Monday is Pavitra's fasting day - no ragi roti or paneer bhurji at dinner.

brand_rules.note: Coriander powder only - a 'Mill Story' batch was rejected; never switch dhaniya powder brand.
Organic dairy/paneer (200 g Malai Paneer), bigger-size eggs, ghee (or Sid's Farm).

ingredient_grade_rules.rule: Lunch: 2 ragi (Pavitra) + 2 normal; Dinner: 2 ragi + 3 normal (up to 8 normal with guests).
Paneer bhurji is the standing preparation, never tofu bhurji; homemade paneer from the Tower-2 neighbour when available, Akshayakalpa fallback; Friday tends to be a masala paneer batch.
Large size only, well cooked, never runny; none boiled Tue/Thu.
English cucumber is the only variety ordered.
Whole raw green moong only - Bina sprouts it herself, never pre-packaged sprouts.
Visually inspect on delivery for pest contamination (worm-infested cauliflower incident).

breakfast_style: Vidhi's daily filling paratha (methi/palak/dal; paneer paratha favourite); spinach-corn sandwich; continental breakfasts on weekends/chef-coach days; amla shot for Pavitra.

cooking_technique.spice: Low spice for everyone - one dish, one spice level
cooking_technique.oil: Low oil is the standard, not just for guests
cooking_technique.marination: No marination - plain, simple preparation throughout
cooking_technique.dinner_structure: Dal + soup every night regardless of the sabzi, with roti and a fixed side of cut onion + English cucumber
cooking_technique.weekday_vs_weekend: Weekday meals deliberately simple; elaborate/continental reserved for weekends and chef-coach sessions

nutrition_direction: Daily dal + soup at dinner for consistent protein/fibre
weekend_pattern: Weekends: more elaborate / continental dishes (chef-coach sessions); Sunday deliveries only after 9 AM.
